markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 这种小句子告诉你，事情**什么时候**发生、**在什么条件下**发生。它由 when、after、until、if、unless 这类词带头，放句首句尾都行。

uses.en: I'll call you [[when]] I get home.
[[After]] you push the code, the tests run.
uses.en_zh: 你推完代码以后，测试就会跑。

uses.en: We'll ship on Friday [[unless]] QA finds a big bug.
uses.en_zh: 除非测试发现大 bug，否则我们周五发布。

time.title: 说时间：when / while / as soon as

items.rule: **while** = 「在……期间」，后面常是一段较长的动作。
items.en: I checked my emails [[while]] the app was building.
items.zh: App 在编译的时候我看了看邮件。

items.rule: **as soon as** = 「一……就……」，比 when 更急。
items.en: Text me [[as soon as]] you land.
items.zh: 你一落地就给我发消息。

items.en: I've worked here [[since]] I left uni.
items.zh: 我大学毕业后就一直在这儿工作。

time.tip: 从句放句首时，后面加逗号；放句尾时，一般不加。

steps.title: 排先后：before / after / once / until
steps.rule: 讲步骤时，用 before（之前）、after（之后）、once（一旦）把两件事排好队。until 是「一直到……为止」。

examples.en: [[Once]] the build passes, we can release.
examples.zh: 一旦构建通过，我们就能发布。

notes: until 加否定，意思是「不到……不……」：We won't release [[until]] the bug is fixed.（bug 不修好我们不发布。）

future.title: 说将来不用 will
future.rule: when、before、after、as soon as、until、if、unless 后面说将来的事，**用一般现在时，不用 will**。will 只放在主句里。
formula: 主句 will + 动词原形

examples.en: [[As soon as]] the server [[come{s}]] back, I'll let you know.
examples.zh: 服务器一恢复我就告诉你。

examples.en: [[If]] it [[rain{s}]] tomorrow, we'll work from home.
examples.zh: 明天要是下雨，我们就在家办公。

wrong.bad: I'll call you when I ~~will get~~ home.
wrong.good: I'll call you when I [[get]] home.

condition.title: 说条件：if / unless / as long as
condition.rule: **unless = if … not**，「除非、要不然」。unless 自己就带「不」，后面别再加 not。**as long as** 是「只要」。

examples.en: [[Unless]] you hurry, you'll miss the train.
examples.zh: 你不快点就要赶不上火车了。

examples.en: You can work from home [[as long as]] you join the stand-up.
examples.zh: 只要参加站会，你就可以在家办公。

examples.en: I won't go [[unless]] you come too.

this.meaning: when：肯定会发生，只是说什么时候
while 后面跟一句话（有主语和动词）
this.en: I fell asleep [[while]] he was talking.

that.meaning: during 后面只跟一个名词

commonMistakes.bad: I'll text you when I ~~will arrive~~.
commonMistakes.why: when 后面说将来用一般现在时。

commonMistakes.bad: Unless you ~~don't~~ hurry, you'll be late.
After I ~~will push~~ the code, the tests run.
commonMistakes.good: [[After]] I push the code, the tests run.

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我到家就给你打电话。
quiz.answer: I'll call you when I get home.
accept: I will call you when I get home.
I'll call you as soon as I get home.
I will call you as soon as I get home.
When I get home, I'll call you.
When I get home, I will call you.
quiz.explain: [[when]] 后面说将来，用一般现在时 get。

quiz.prompt: I checked my emails ___ the app was building.
I've worked here ___ I left uni.
___ you merge, run the tests.（合并之前先跑测试）
翻译：bug 不修好，我们不发布。
quiz.answer: We won't release until the bug is fixed.
accept: We will not release until the bug is fixed.
We won't release it until the bug is fixed.
We won't release until the bug has been fixed.
We won't release until the bug's fixed.

quiz.prompt: As soon as the server ___ (come) back, I'll let you know.

traps.note: as soon as 后面不用 will。

quiz.explain: as soon as 后面说将来用一般现在时：[[come{s}]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：I'll text you when I will arrive.
quiz.answer: I'll text you when I arrive.
accept: I will text you when I arrive.
quiz.explain: when 后面用一般现在时：I [[arrive]]。

quiz.prompt: If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we'll work from home.
quiz.explain: if 后面说将来用一般现在时：[[rain{s}]]。

quiz.prompt: 用 unless 改写：If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.
quiz.answer: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the train.
accept: Unless you hurry, you will miss the train.
You'll miss the train unless you hurry.
You will miss the train unless you hurry.

traps.input: Unless you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.
traps.note: unless 已经有「不」，去掉 don't。

quiz.prompt: You can work from home ___ you join the stand-up.
改错：Unless you don't sign up, you can't join.
quiz.answer: Unless you sign up, you can't join.
accept: Unless you sign up, you cannot join.
quiz.explain: unless 已经带「不」，去掉 don't。
后面只有名词 the meeting，用 [[during]]。

quiz.prompt: 说一件肯定会发生的事：「我做完了就发邮件给你」
options: When I finish, I'll email you.
If I finish, I'll email you.
quiz.answer: When I finish, I'll email you.

quiz.prompt: 改错：After I will push the code, the tests run.
quiz.answer: After I push the code, the tests run.

openTask.prompt: 用 3 句话说说你发布一个版本的步骤或明天的安排。至少用到 before / after / as soon as 中的一个，再用一次 unless。
rules: when / before / after / as soon as / if / unless 后面说将来用一般现在时，不用 will
openTask.note: 规则判从句里有没有 will 和 unless 用法（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
